title: Symplectic Graph Neural Networks for Energy Conservation in Physical Systems
summary: Standard neural network dynamics simulators suffer from secular energy drift over extended time horizons. We introduce Symplectic Graph Neural Networks (SGNN), which embed Hamiltonian canonical equations directly into message-passing layers. Across 100,000 rollout steps of non-linear $N$-body gravitational and molecular dynamics, SGNN maintains bounded energy drift below $1.4 \times 10^{-6}$ while preserving symplectic geometry.
